meta.name: depmap
meta.description: Query the Cancer Dependency Map (DepMap) for cancer cell line gene dependency scores (CRISPR Chronos), drug sensitivity data, and gene effect profiles. Use for identifying cancer-specific vulnerabilities, synthetic lethal interactions, and validating oncology drug targets.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 查询癌症依赖图谱数据，发现肿瘤靶点
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在癌症研究中使用DepMap数据筛选基因依赖或药物敏感性。
copy.tagline_en: Query cancer dependency map data to discover tumor targets.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to analyze cancer gene dependencies or drug sensitivity data from DepMap.

howto.what: Claude 能查询 DepMap 数据库,获取 CRISPR 基因效应评分、药物敏感性等数据;可找特定基因依赖的细胞系、做突变与依赖关联分析、找共必需基因。
howto.when: 当用户提到癌症细胞系基因依赖、合成致死、药物靶点验证等查询或分析时触发。

say.text: 查一下 KRAS 在肺癌细胞系里的基因效应分数
say.note: 会返回各细胞系的依赖分数列表

say.text: 找与 TP53 共必需的基因
say.note: 会返回共必需基因相关性排序

say.text: 比较 BRCA1 突变与野生型细胞系对 PARP1 的依赖
say.note: 会做突变分组统计并给出 p 值

howto.what_en: Claude can query the DepMap database for CRISPR gene effect scores, drug sensitivity data, and related profiles. It can identify cell lines dependent on a gene, run mutation-dependency biomarker tests, and find co-essential genes.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks for cancer cell line gene dependency, synthetic lethality, drug target validation, or similar DepMap-related queries.

say_en.text: Check KRAS gene effect scores in lung cancer cell lines.
say_en.note: Returns a list of dependency scores per cell line.
Returns co-essential genes ranked by correlation.

say_en.text: Compare PARP1 dependency between BRCA1-mutant and wild-type cell lines.
say_en.note: Runs grouped mutation analysis and returns a p-value.
